analysis.summary: During FY26, Durlax Top Surface Ltd reported strong financial growth with revenue increasing by nearly 50% year-on-year to reach ₹185 Crore and net profit rising by over 60% to ₹13 Crore. The company achieved a major national infrastructure credential as its flagship LUXOR solid surface was installed by Larsen & Toubro for the Kartavya Bhavan 3 project in New Delhi. Management expanded the business portfolio by launching the TRUDO brand into the decorative laminate and panel market, altering its object clause to trade in adjacent construction materials, and raising capital through a Rights Issue. Looking ahead, management established a long-term target of crossing ₹1,000 Crore in revenue by FY30.
